$doc: docs/DESIGN_Scenario_Regression.md §3 — S7 (CE-2158 F-c) bounding overwatch. Judge (4)-(5): the squad runs BoundingOverwatch, nobody fires before contact, on contact the squad fires within 5.5 s (and at the Hostile). TRIAGE (CE-4042): the draft used 'a rifleman within 100 m of the Hostile' as the contact proxy (header: 'unseen until ~70 m'), but in this build the squad has contact at 17.75 s from ~150 m (first rounds 17.78 s, target-less suppression; the first round AT the Hostile 18.23 s) — so the proxy was wrong, not the behaviour. Contact IS readable: SquadCognitiveState.Contacts.Count on the Squad entity (the commander's shared pool). NOT expressed: (1) halves not moving together, (2) bounds ending within 1.5 m of cover, (3) swaps on 'set', (5)'s 3.5 s suppress window (squad drill / orders, DESIGN §9).
